summary.en: Use dataclasses for records, independent mutable defaults and clearly limited frozen instances.
summary.bn: ডেটা ক্লাস দিয়ে রেকর্ড বানাও, প্রতিটি অবজেক্টের জন্য আলাদা লিস্ট রাখো এবং frozen-এর সীমা বোঝো।

notes: Data classes predate Python 3.10. Factories are portable across 3.10–3.12; mutable-default rejection details changed in 3.11.

examples.explanationHtml: The generated frozen rule rejects assigning label. Appending to the existing list remains possible because it changes the contained list rather than the field binding.

examples.explanationHtml: The generated initializer sets marks, then __post_init__ checks the domain. Zero remains valid, while 101 raises the explicitly chosen ValueError.

practice.title: Make a course record
practice.statementHtml: Read a course code on one line and integer credits from 0 to 6 on the next. Define a Course data class and print code:credits.
hints: The generated initializer follows field order.

practice.title: Compare two points
practice.statementHtml: Read four integers x1 y1 x2 y2. Define a Point data class with x and y. Print whether the two constructed points compare equal as True or False.

practice.title: Build independent attendance groups
practice.statementHtml: Read one line of integer rolls, possibly empty. Append them to the first of two Group data class instances using a list factory. Print the two list lengths separated by one space.
hints: Do not pass a shared explicit list to both instances.

practice.title: Revise a frozen booking
practice.statementHtml: Read a room name then two nonnegative integer seat counts on the next line. Construct a frozen Booking(room, old_count). Use replace to make a revised count. Print old_count new_count and whether the two objects are identical.
hints: replace constructs a new record even when the field values match.

keyPoints.en: @dataclass generates routine methods from annotated fields.
keyPoints.bn: @dataclass ফিল্ডের অ্যানোটেশন দেখে দরকারি কিছু মেথড লিখে দেয়।

keyPoints.en: Annotations do not validate field values at runtime.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যানোটেশন থাকলেই রান করার সময় ফিল্ডের টাইপ যাচাই হয় না।

keyPoints.en: field(default_factory=list) makes a new list for each instance.
keyPoints.bn: field(default_factory=list) প্রতিটি অবজেক্টের জন্য নতুন লিস্ট বানায়।

keyPoints.en: Generated equality compares fields of the same concrete class.
keyPoints.bn: তৈরি করে দেওয়া সমতার নিয়ম একই ক্লাসের ফিল্ডগুলো মেলায়।

keyPoints.en: frozen=True prevents normal field assignment, not deep mutation.
keyPoints.bn: frozen=True সাধারণ ফিল্ড অ্যাসাইনমেন্ট আটকায়, ভেতরের লিস্ট বদলানো আটকায় না।
অর্ডার ধরে তুলনা চাইলে আলাদা করে order=True দিতে হয়।

examQuestions.question: Explain why a roster should use field(default_factory=list).
examQuestions.answerHtml: The factory is called when an instance needs its default, giving each roster a fresh list. Passing list() supplies a value rather than a callable, and an explicit shared list can still create aliases.

examQuestions.question: Explain why frozen=True is not deep immutability.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Normal field assignment is rejected, but referenced objects keep their own operations. A contained list can still accept append. A stable record should use appropriately immutable contained values and must still satisfy hashability rules.

examQuestions.question: Design a data class for a course with a code, default credits and independent enrolled rolls.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
Declare required code: str first, credits: int = 3 next, and rolls: list[int] = field(default_factory=list). A method can return len(self.rolls). Add explicit domain validation if credits must lie in a fixed range; annotations alone do not enforce it.

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Course:
    code: str
    credits: int = 3
    rolls: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)

    def size(self):
        return len(self.rolls)

Course("CSE212") starts with three credits and its own empty rolls list. The size method therefore returns zero.
